title: Welcome to the Bea waitlist!
body: Thanks for joining the movement. Answer today's prompt, invite friends, and climb your campus leaderboard to unlock rewards.

title: Ambassador competition update
body: Your referral network is what counts. The top ambassadors by total network win the grand ambassador prize — keep sharing your link!

title: Northeastern is climbing the ranks!
body: You're now #2 in Boston. A few more responses and invites could take the top spot this week.

title: Boston just unlocked new prizes
body: Boston hit its participation target — new market rewards are now live. Check the rewards tab to see what you can unlock.

title: Day 3 prompt is live
body: What's a green flag you look for in someone? Share your answer for points and a shot at the daily winner bonus.

title: Final 48 hours — invite to win
body: The competition wraps soon. Every friend who joins from your link moves you up the leaderboard. Make them count!
